subject: Coastal Summit: catering overage PO request and p-card exception
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@coastaldevs.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Catering estimate + deposit for Coastal Summit (Nov 18)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for confirming the Coastal Summit headcount (approx. 220). Attached is the updated catering estimate from BrightFork — they've had a 12% menu surge due to seasonal protein costs, so the total is higher than the original. BrightFork is requesting a 50% deposit to secure food truck slots and rentals.

Numbers at a glance:
- Estimate total (food + staffing + rentals): $8,500
- Deposit requested (50%): $4,250
- Previously budgeted in our request: $6,000

We can push a slightly different menu to shave ~ $600 but that would change the agreed menu. Please let me know if Redwood can cover the incremental spend or if we should reduce portions. Attachment: BrightFork_estimate_v2.pdf

Best,
Amy
Amy Chen
Events, Coastal Devs Inc.
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Cc: amy@coastaldevs.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catering estimate + deposit for Coastal Summit (Nov 18)

Marissa / Laura / Logan —

Forwarding Amy's updated estimate. The estimate pushes our expected spend from $6,000 to $8,500 (difference $2,500). We committed to this customer in the sponsorship SOW (see signed doc attached), but the finance-approved spend cap on the PO we requested was $6,000. Two asks:

1) Can finance sign off on a PO up to $8,500 (or at least authorize the $4,250 deposit) so we don't lose the catering slot?
2) If not, do we reduce the menu (Amy said ~ $600 savings) or cover the overage from marketing contingencies?

If we proceed with the deposit on p-card, we will need a p-card exception for the $4,250 deposit (vendor requires card). Otherwise we need a PO and a separate wire.

Attachments: Coastal_Summit_SOW_signed.pdf, BrightFork_estimate_v2.pdf

Can you reply with PO number or direction? I need to confirm with Amy by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com

Date: 2026-11-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catering estimate + deposit for Coastal Summit (Nov 18)

Soojin —

I support moving forward with the vendor to preserve the experience. Approve pursuing full estimate on the condition that finance issues a PO for the event cap and that cost is coded to the Events fund (cost center 6004). If we can only get the deposit covered today, please secure that and we'll reconcile final invoice next week.

Please ask finance for: PO (target: $8,500) and confirmation of coding to 6004-SALES-EVENTS. If p-card exception is required, include justification and list of attendees for audit.

-Marissa
VP, Field Marketing
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catering estimate + deposit for Coastal Summit (Nov 18)

Team —

Finance can approve a PO up to $8,500 given the signed SOW and partner relationship, but we need a short p-card exception memo if you decide to use a card for the deposit. Options:

A) Issue PO 450-12-3 (placeholder) for $8,500 and submit for signatures — payment via vendor invoice/wire.
B) Approve p-card one-time use up to $4,250 for deposit only; require completed p-card exception form + attendee list and reconciliation within 5 business days after event.

Please confirm which path you want. If going with A, I'll create the PO and route. If B, send the exception justification (why vendor requires card, why wiring is not feasible) and I'll expedite. Also confirm final cost center code: you mentioned 6004 — confirm full string (6004-SALES-EVENTS).

-Ben
Finance Manager
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: amy@coastaldevs.com, ops@brightfork.com
Date: 2026-11-04T14:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catering estimate + deposit for Coastal Summit (Nov 18)

Ben — thanks. We will proceed with option B: p-card one-time for the deposit. Rationale: BrightFork requires card to hold trucks/rentals and vendor does not accept partial wiring without a PO. We want to secure menu and deposits today to keep timeline.

Attached: short p-card exception memo (below), signed SOW, vendor estimate.

P-card exception memo (summary):
- Event: Coastal Summit at Pier 7 (Nov 18), expected 220 pax.
- Vendor: BrightFork Catering — requires 50% deposit via card to confirm bookings.
- Amount: $4,250 (one-time).
- Business justification: customer sponsorship SOW obligates Redwood to provide hospitality; losing deposit would risk venue logistics and customer goodwill. Wire infeasible due to vendor timeline and bank cutoffs.
- Audit items: attendee list within 5 business days post-event; final vendor invoice and reconciliation to be submitted to finance.
- Cost coding: 6004-SALES-EVENTS

Action items (I will own):
- Ben: please approve one-time p-card use up to $4,250 and confirm any additional documentation needed.
- Marissa: confirm you approve the menu overage and will absorb in FY26 field event budget.
- Amy / BrightFork: hold the deposit window for 48 hours while we process.

Thanks all — I will upload the signed forms to the Drive link and notify Amy once the card is charged or PO is issued.

Best,
Soojin
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: BrightFork_estimate_v2.pdf, Coastal_Summit_SOW_signed.pdf
